HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAMMER_STUN_POWER.title: Stun
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAMMER_STUN_POWER.descr: Current Stun: [blue]{Amount}[/blue]/{Threshold}. This enemy is Stunned at the threshold. Its next threshold doubles after each Stun.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAMMER_STUN_RESISTANCE_: This enemy's Stun threshold has increased.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_OVERCHARGE_POWER.title: Overcharge
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_OVERCHARGE_POWER.descri: All cards that Release Charge cost 0 and do not clear Charge this turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FOCUS_POWER.title: Focus
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FOCUS_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, gain Charge, or draw if Charge is full.
The first time each turn you finish releasing a card with at least 3 Charge, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_DASH_JUICE_POWER.title: Masterful Positioning
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_DASH_JUICE_POWER.descri: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block for each Charge.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FELYNE_KO_TECHNIQUE_POW: Attacks inflict additional Stun equal to Energy spent times [blue]{EnergyMultiplier}[/blue], plus [blue]{BonusStun}[/blue].
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PILE_DRIVER_POWER.title: Pile Driver
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PILE_DRIVER_POWER.descr: Each stack makes Attacks deal 50% more damage to enemies with Stun, or 100% more damage if they are Stunned.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CONCUSSION_RESONANCE_PO: At the start of each turn, lose [blue]{ChargeLoss}[/blue] Charge and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_IMPACT_BURST_POWER.desc: After a multi-hit Attack, inflict additional Stun equal to its hits times [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FACE_OFF_POWER.title: Face Off
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FACE_OFF_POWER.descript:
The chosen enemy deals 0 damage to you.
Removed at the end of the enemy turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FACE_OFF_POWER.smartDes:
{ApplierName} deals 0 damage to you.
Removed at the end of the enemy turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_WEAVE_AND_BONK_POWER.de: When attacked, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to the attacker. Removed at the start of your next turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_COUNTER_FORM_POWER.desc: After you use an Attack on an enemy that intends to attack, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_AFTERSHOCK_POWER.title: Aftershock
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_AFTERSHOCK_POWER.descri: At the start of the applier's next turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Stun.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_ADAMANT_SEED_POWER.desc: Until the start of your next turn, enemy attacks cannot reduce your Charge.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_MIGHT_SEED_POWER.title: Might Pill
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHALLENGER_POWER.title: Challenger
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHALLENGER_POWER.descri: At the start of each turn, if any enemy intends to attack, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Strength this turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_WIREBUG_CONTINUATION_PO: Whenever you play a card that spends at least {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Charge.
Attacks deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue]% more damage to Vulnerable enemies.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HARDER_WITH_EVERY_SMASH: When you play a card that Releases Charge at Charge level 3 or higher, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Strength.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PARTBREAKER_POWER.title: Partbreaker
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PARTBREAKER_POWER.descr: After each Attack, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Vulnerable to enemies that took unblocked damage.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_BLOOD_RITE_POWER.title: Custom Lifesteal
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_BLOOD_RITE_POWER.descri: After each Attack, calculate each enemy separately and heal HP equal to the total HP it lost from that Attack divided by 10, rounded down.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHARGE_SWITCH_STRENGTH_: Gain Strength equal to (your current Charge plus 1) times [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_WIREFALL_POWER.title: Wirefall
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_WIREFALL_POWER.descript: During the enemy turn, after the first Attack deals unblocked damage to you, all later Attacks deal 0 damage to you. At the start of your turn, lose 1 stack.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FARCASTER_POWER.title: Farcaster
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FARCASTER_POWER.descrip: During the enemy turn, take no damage, gain no statuses, and have no cards added to your combat piles. At the end of the enemy turn, lose 1 stack.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FREE_MEAL_POWER.title: Free Meal
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FREE_MEAL_POWER.descrip: The next Potion you use will not be consumed.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_LUCKY_VOUCHER_POWER.des: At the end of combat, you may reroll the card reward once.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHARGE_SWITCH_COURAGE_P: This turn, whenever you play an Attack, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Charge.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_VALOR_STYLE_POWER.title: Valor Style
